description: This PHP source file sets up the environment for the Revive Adserver delivery engine, including polyfills, configuration variables, server environment initialization, timezone management, hostname retrieval, and include path setup.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Polyfill for the 'each' function if it does not exist.

methods.name: setupConfigVariables
methods.description: Initializes global configuration variables used by delivery and admin parts.

methods.name: setupServerVariables
methods.description: Ensures $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] is set, initializing it if missing.

methods.name: setupDeliveryConfigVariables
methods.description: Defines environment constants and loads configuration for delivery environment.

methods.name: OA_setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone and updates the PEAR Date_TimeZone default.

methods.name: OA_setTimeZoneLocal
methods.description: Sets the timezone to the user's preferred timezone or UTC if not set.

methods.name: setupIncludePath
methods.description: Configures the PHP include path for PEAR and Zend libraries.
